title: 第一卷 第17章 海河十八跌
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
夜色渐沉，津门码头的喧嚣终于沉淀下来。

    小洋楼的灯光昏黄，透着一股子难得的温馨。

    陆川推门而入，带着一身浓烈的酒气。

    屋内，陆小鱼正坐在桌边，面前摆着一碗热气腾腾的醒酒汤。

    几日调养，她那张原本惨白的小脸终于有了几分血色，不再是那种随时会断气的模样。

    见陆川回来，她挣扎着要起身。

    “哥，你回来了。”

    陆川摆摆手，大步走过去，按着她的肩膀让她坐下。

    “坐着别动。”

    “大夫说了，你现在需要静养，别整这些虚头巴脑的。”

    陆川端起醒酒汤，一饮而尽。

    汤很甜，带着姜丝的辛辣和甘草的回甘，顺着喉咙滚进胃里，驱散了不少寒意。

    陆小鱼看着陆川，眼神慢慢的有些迷离。

    “哥，你说我是不是在做梦？”

    她忽然开口，声音很轻，带着一丝不易察觉的颤抖。

    “以前在猪笼巷，每次做梦吃肉，醒来周围全是馊水味。”

    “现在住小洋楼，有好多好吃的，还有人毕恭毕敬地喊我陆小姐......”

    “我怕明天一睁眼，又回到了那个漏雨的窝棚里。”

    陆川放下碗，看着她那双充满不安的大眼睛。

    他伸出手，粗糙的大手包裹住她冰凉的小手。

    “这不是梦。”

    陆川语气平淡，却透着一股子不容置疑的硬气。

    “猪笼巷那是过去式了。”

    “只要我陆川还有一口气，你就再也不用闻馊水味。”

    “以后，咱们只有好日子过。”

    陆小鱼吸了吸鼻子，用力点了点头，双手紧紧地抱住陆川。

    没一会，就传来一阵均匀的呼吸声。

    陆川轻轻地将小鱼抱起，将她送回房间。

    看着熟睡的妹妹，陆川眼中的温情瞬间收敛，取而代之的是一抹冷冽。

    在这个世道，想安稳过日子，光靠嘴说没用。

    得靠拳头！

    得靠比别人更狠、更硬的实力！

    【每日结算面板开启】

    【今日结算：击杀青帮练骨境一人，击杀青帮四十二人，重伤青帮三十八人，击伤海河帮练骨境一人。】

    【获得：大洋+30，气血值+15，武道经验+15年！】

    【目前每日结算等级LV1，每日奖励额外X1倍】

    又有武道经验！

    陆川眼中精光闪过，顺手将3点的通用经验夹在结算等级上。

    【结算等级：9/100】

    按照当前的经验，想要将结算等级晋升到二级，至少需要一个月时间。

    陆川不着急，他现在有的是时间。

    至于新获得的15年武道经验，他没有犹豫，再次加在了大力鹰爪功上。

    陆川只觉得脑中时间飞逝，自己孤身一人站在原地疯狂演练大力鹰爪功。

    不知疲倦、毫不停歇！

    一年，两年，三年......

    眨眼之间，十五年过去了！

    “轰！”

    好似雷霆炸响，大力鹰爪功好似真被陆川习练不坠的疯狂磨炼了十五年。

    无数有关于大力鹰爪功的经验关注进陆川的脑海之中。

    同时他浑身的筋骨、肌肉、皮膜、气血都在疯狂鼓动。

    浑身的青筋好似一条条粗大的蚯蚓，在陆川的体表疯狂游走。

    他整个人瞬间变得通红，好似烧熟的大虾一般。

    好一会，蒸腾的热气消散，陆川再次变回寻常那样。

    大力鹰爪功的等级也从先前的炉火纯青变成了登峰造极。

    海河帮的人都只知道自己力量大，善使一根铁棍。

    却没人只知道，自己最强的是爪功。

    在这险恶的世道下，藏一点底牌才是保命的关键。

    次日清晨。

    陆川刚睁眼，门就被敲响了。

    “陆爷，帮主请您过去一趟。”

    门外是张宏，语气恭敬，甚至带着几分敬畏。

    陆川穿好衣服，推门而出。

    张宏立刻迎上来，满脸堆笑。

    “陆爷，昨日那一战，您可是露了大脸了。”

    “帮里上下钦佩不已，被青帮压了这么多年，总算出了一口恶气。”

    “现在谁不知道咱们海河帮的镇涛堂，出了个活阎王。”

    陆川没接话，只是淡淡道：“带路。”
content_en:
The night is getting darker, and the hustle and bustle of Jinmen Pier has finally settled down.

    The lights in the small foreign-style building were dim, giving off a rare warmth.

    Lu Chuan pushed open the door and walked in, smelling strongly of alcohol.

    In the room, Lu Xiaoyu was sitting at the table, with a steaming bowl of hangover soup in front of him.

    After a few days of recuperation, her originally pale little face finally gained some color, and no longer looked like she might die at any moment.

    Seeing Lu Chuan back, she struggled to get up.

    "Brother, you are back."

    Lu Chuan waved his hand, strode over, pressed her shoulders and asked her to sit down.

    "Sit still."

    "The doctor said you need to rest now and don't do all this nonsense."

    Lu Chuan picked up the hangover soup and drank it all in one gulp.

    The soup is very sweet, with the spiciness of shredded ginger and the sweetness of licorice. It rolls down the throat and into the stomach, dispelling a lot of chills.

    Lu Xiaoyu looked at Lu Chuan, his eyes slowly becoming blurry.

    "Brother, do you think I'm dreaming?"

    She suddenly spoke, her voice was very soft, with an imperceptible tremor.

    "I used to live in Pig Ling Alley. Every time I dreamed about eating meat, I would wake up surrounded by the smell of sour water."

    "Now I live in a small Western-style building. There are a lot of delicious food, and some people respectfully call me Miss Lu..."

    "I'm afraid that when I open my eyes tomorrow, I'll be back in that leaky shack again."

    Lu Chuan put down the bowl and looked at her big, uneasy eyes.

    He stretched out his hand and wrapped his rough hand around her cold little hand.

    "This is not a dream."

    Lu Chuan's tone was calm, but there was an undeniable firmness to it.

    "Pig Pen Alley is a thing of the past."

    "As long as I, Lu Chuan, have breath, you will never have to smell the smell of sour water again."

    "From now on, we can only live a good life."

    Lu Xiaoyu sniffed, nodded vigorously, and hugged Lu Chuan tightly with both hands.

    After a while, there was a sound of even breathing.

    Lu Chuan gently picked up Xiaoyu and took her back to the room.

    Looking at his sleeping sister, the warmth in Lu Chuan's eyes instantly disappeared, replaced by a cold look.

    In this world, if you want to live a stable life, it is useless to just rely on words.

    You have to rely on your fists!

    You have to rely on being more ruthless and tougher than others!

    [Daily settlement panel opens]

    [Today’s settlement: One person from the Qing Gang was killed in the bone training realm, 42 people from the Qing Gang were killed, 38 people from the Qing Gang were seriously injured, and one person in the Haihe Gang was injured in the bone training realm. 】

    [Obtained: Dayang +30, health value +15, martial arts experience +15 years! 】

    [The current daily settlement level is LV1, and the daily reward is extra X1 times]

    Another martial arts experience!

    Lu Chuan's eyes flashed, and he conveniently added 3 points of general experience to the settlement level.

    [Settlement level: 9/100]

    According to current experience, it will take at least a month to upgrade the settlement level to level two.

    Lu Chuan was not in a hurry, he had plenty of time now.

    As for the newly acquired 15 years of martial arts experience, he did not hesitate and once again added to the powerful eagle claw technique.

    Lu Chuan only felt that time flew by in his mind, and he stood alone and frantically practiced the powerful eagle claw technique.

    Tireless and never stopping!

    One year, two years, three years...

    In the blink of an eye, fifteen years have passed!

    "Boom!"

    It was like thunder exploding, and the powerful eagle claw skill seemed to have been honed by Lu Chuan's crazy practice of not falling for fifteen years.

    Countless experiences about the powerful Eagle Claw Skill came into Lu Chuan's mind.

    At the same time, all the tendons, muscles, membranes, and blood all over his body were beating like crazy.

    The veins all over his body were like thick earthworms, swimming crazily on Lu Chuan's body.

    His whole body turned red instantly, like a cooked prawn.

    After a while, the steaming heat dissipated, and Lu Chuan returned to his normal self again.

    The level of the powerful eagle claw skill has also changed from the previous proficiency to the pinnacle.

    Everyone in the Haihe Gang only knows that they are powerful and good at using an iron rod.

    But no one only knows that his strongest skill is his claw skill.

    In this dangerous world, hiding a few trump cards is the key to saving your life.

    Early next morning.

    As soon as Lu Chuan opened his eyes, there was a knock on the door.

    "Master Lu, the leader of the gang would like to ask you to come over."

    Outside the door was Zhang Hong, his tone was respectful, even a little awe-inspiring.

    Lu Chuan got dressed and pushed out the door.

    Zhang Hong came up to him immediately with a smile on his face.

    "Master Lu, you showed your face in yesterday's battle."

    "Everyone in the gang admires him greatly. After being suppressed by the Qing Gang for so many years, he finally feels bad."

    "Now who doesn't know that our Haihe Gang's Zhentao Hall has a living King of Hell?"

    Lu Chuan did not answer, but simply said: "Lead the way."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 17 The Haihe River fell eighteen times
